description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of a request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request is different.

description.zh:
待查询的基础型全球加速实例的加速地域实例ID。

您可以调用[GetBasicAccelerator](~~2253380~~)查询加速地域实例ID。
description.en:
The acceleration region instance ID of the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance that you want to query.

You can invoke [GetBasicAccelerator](~~2253380~~) to query the acceleration region instance ID.

description.zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The region ID of Global Accelerator. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

title.zh: 查询基础型全球加速实例的闲置加速IP数量
title.en: Query the number of idle accelerated IP addresses of a basic global accelerator instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga get-basic-accelerate-ip-idle-count --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --ip-set-id ips-bp11r5jb8ogp122xl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
